body:
I had my first encounter with Oxymorphone in November 2009 when I snorted 5mg with my friend Zach, who was moving some to make extra cash. It was like no other opiate I had ever experienced, and I loved every second of it, from the breathtaking rush to the warm and euphoric nod. Opiates have always been my favorite family of narcotics, as they relax my normally stressful mind and don't leave me feeling strung out and tired like speed or coke.
On this occasion, months later, another wave of Oxymorphone came through town. I was having a boring and stressful day and was feeling down. I was in luck and my best friend Stephen had skipped school and came to meet me during lunch at a pizza place near campus during my lunch break. I hopped in his car and he poured out 10mg of the greenish-white powdered Opana that he had prepared just for me. The green comes from the extended release coating on the pill. Some people suck it off, but I usually just leave it on for convenience. The only noticeable difference this makes is a greenish tint in the powder, and for this reason me and my fellow users christened them 'Leprechaun Lines'.
I retrieved a Blockbuster gift card from my wallet and shaped up a rather fat line on top of Stephen's chemistry textbook (go figure), rolled up a $20 bill and snorted that shit up like a vacuum cleaner. After that, me and Stephen smoked a cigarette and said are goodbyes as I left to go back to class.
Walking back to school, I felt the sweet opiate coming on. It spread from my head and down my spine into my extremities. Nothing can compare to the amazing full body sensation I felt. I walked into my Sociology class and melted into my chair. We were discussing a subject I cannot recall, though I remember that I enjoyed contributing to the conversation.The academic stress that had plagued me before lunch seemed miles away, and was replaced with a warm contentment that flooded my soul with elation. I even enjoyed my last class of the day, Algebra II, which I normally despise. Towards the end of the day the feeling slowly faded away, so I popped some Percocet and spent the afternoon playing Assassin's Creed 2.
After the last of the drugs wore off, I found myself in the familiar irritable state that follows an enjoyable high. According to my friends, during this phase, I have the tendency to become very unpleasant to be around, so I'm glad I was alone so I couldn't be hurtful to my friends. Overall it had turned out to be a very pleasant day, thanks to that little, green, stop-sign shaped pill that packs such a pleasurable punch.
